compute_manhattan_distance_energy: compute the total manhattan distance energy for moving each matrix element to its sorted position
test_f_gold_function: test the f_gold function against multiple matrix inputs to verify correct minimum cost calculation
refactor_f_gold_for_performance: refactor the f_gold function to optimize the nested loop matrix traversal for larger matrices
summarize_matrix_sorting_algorithm: summarize the matrix sorting algorithm that maps each value to its destination row and column using division and modulo
